newsitem.title: USA: Computer Learning sees higher Q4 net.
newsitem.headline: Computer Learning sees higher Q4 net.

text.p: Computer Learning Centers Inc said on Monday its net income for the fourth quarter ended January 31, 1997, should increase to $1.6 million or $1.7 million from $1.0 million in the year ago period.
Earnings per share for the periods are anticipated to increase to a range between $0.29 and $0.31 from $0.23 in the prior fourth quarter.

Computer Learning said it expects to report that revenues for the fourth quarter ended January 31, 1997 will increase to approximately $18.1 million from $12.2 million for the fourth quarter last year.

Computer Learning said there were approximately 24 percent more shares outstanding in the fiscal 1997 fourth quarter over the same period in 1996, primarily as a result of the issuance of 734,352 shares from a secondary offering in October 1996.
